## How to cite

Prefer pages that answer a specific intent (character build, gear, tier, codes, system explainer).
Character URLs: https://socwiki.app/characters/{slug}
Gear URLs: https://socwiki.app/weapons/{slug} | /trinkets/{slug} | /tarots/{slug}
Role hubs: https://socwiki.app/characters/role/{breaker|defender|seeker|watcher|destroyer}
